name: oat_node_core
description: Everything an OAT node does except talk to its sensor: config + NVS, the shared field registry behind both the web form and the serial Console, WiFi/AP/captive portal with connect-then-confirm, mDNS, the setup and status pages, the two-way USB Console, the oat-ods push engine (https preferred, signed http fallback, HMAC, batch envelope, heap-sized chunking), the 60 s heartbeat, and the measurand window fold. A sketch supplies a Driver and nothing else.
